Class ConfigurableEffect

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingws.gc8.Model.Cards.BuildingCard.ConfigurableEffect
All Implemented Interfaces:
BuildingEffect, Serializable
public class ConfigurableEffect extends Object implements BuildingEffect
A parameterizable BuildingEffect that covers most building cards in the game. Each instance is configured from JSON and uses only a subset of its fields;
